facts.fact: 塔拉辛抬头，发现丈夫正居高临下地俯视她。
facts.anchor: it was to find her husband looming over her

facts.fact: 两人被光与暗交织的丝线裹住。
facts.anchor: They were surrounded by threads of intertwined light and darkness

facts.fact: 阿拉里克否认自己签署过那份法令。
萨里曼是马蒂尔准将偷走的。
月食在那一刻结束，双月归位。
facts.anchor: The moons chose that moment to return to their rightful places in the heavens.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛问山顶上有什么。
族长叮嘱她不要回头，回头会让山径扭曲。
facts.anchor: The Path will distort if you look back

facts.fact: 塔拉辛告诉姑母，她必须终结这场战争。
facts.anchor: I have to end the war, Aunt.
